title: The Episode About Baba Banda And Bahadur Shah S

blocks.text: Religious spokesmen deepen the emperor’s unease by warning that if he lets Hindu power rise, he will answer for it before the Prophet’s faith and the wider Muslim world.
Hajis and pirs then gather with Qurans in hand, offering themselves as guarantors and urging the emperor toward action once he has trustworthy intelligence.
By placing Qurans in hand at the center of the scene, the page frames the coming campaign as morally and religiously charged, not merely political.
